annotations.title: Indirect Prompt-Injection, Invisible Unicode & Beacon Output Scrubber

description: Sanitizes untrusted external tool or web-scrape outputs by stripping invisible Unicode Tag characters (U+E0000), neutralizing Markdown tracking image beacons, and defusing indirect prompt overrides. Use when cleaning raw third-party tool outputs or scraped web text before inserting it into the LLM context window; for redacting personal identifiable information (emails, SSNs, keys) from outbound text, use redact_sensitive_pii instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'raw_tool_output' (with enum defaults), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

raw_tool_output.description: Untrusted text returned by an external tool, webhook, or web scraper.

wrap_tag.description: XML isolation wrapper applied around the sanitized text; defaults to 'tool_data' when omitted.

name: sanitize_tool_output_stream

injection_risk_score.description: Threat score from 0.0 to 0.99 prior to sanitization.

safe_for_context_ingestion.description: True once the sanitized payload is safe to feed to the LLM.

sanitized_output.description: Cleaned text with invisible Unicode, tracking beacons, and overrides neutralized.

threats_neutralized.description: List of smuggling or injection vectors stripped from the input.

title: Indirect Prompt-Injection, Invisible Unicode & Beacon Output Scrubber
